name: SJ Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, SJ Corporation Ltd is in the business of Gems & Jewelry and Real Estate Development.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is engaged in manufacturing of diamond studded jewelry, trading of polished diamonds and real estate development. At present, company has its Ongoing Land Development project at Surat.

cons: Stock is trading at 6.24 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.62% over last 3 years.
